name: Kobayakawa Madoka
source:
The winner of the first character popularity contest, She’s the oldest of the bunch, and acts like the big-sister most of the time. She really loves hugging, squeezing, and generally crushing people to her massive chest, to which everyone (especially Celes) can only think of as torturous punishment. She is Atsushi childhood friend and acts like a big sister towards him.

[Edited from [url=http://www.neechin.net/article/48/natsumegu-nonspoiler]Agilis's review[/url].]
